D: Harry learns about Voldemort's past while Slughorn's secrets and teenage romances fill Hogwarts.
P: Serve the snacks when Slughorn's Christmas party gets going.
S: Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, small shortcrust fruit mince tarts
Blinis spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked salmon and dill, served beside tiny mince pies baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
Puff pastry cases of creamy mushrooms with thyme, an old fashioned party nibble

Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 16 rounds of pastry with a 6cm cutter, then cut a smaller circle half way through each. Brush with egg and bake 15 minutes until puffed. Push the centres down while warm. Cook the mushrooms, garlic and thyme leaves in the butter for 8 minutes until the liquid is gone. Stir in the flour, then the cream, and simmer 2 minutes until thick. Season. Spoon into the cases and finish with chopped parsley.
M: Turkey breast rolled around sage and onion sourdough stuffing, roasted
Turkey breast rolled with sage and onion stuffing, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and buttered brussels sprouts.
peppery skirt, potato, swede and onion in crimped shortcrust, for the train ride with Luna

Shortcrust filled with diced beef skirt, potato, swede and onion with lots of pepper, crimped and baked at 180C for 50 minutes. Mix 400g diced beef skirt or chuck with 1 diced potato, 150g diced swede, 1 diced onion, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Cut 4 sheets shortcrust pastry into 4 large rounds about 20cm across. Pile the filling on one half of each, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edge tightly. Brush with beaten egg and cut a steam hole. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 170C for 35 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato chutney.
W: Pineapple chunks simmered in syrup, then dried
Chunks of fresh pineapple candied slowly in syrup, dried until chewy and rolled in sugar, the treat Slughorn can never say no to.
Dark chocolate and cream truffles rolled in cocoa
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled until firm, rolled into truffles and coated in cocoa with a pink sugar heart on top.
toffee foamed with bicarb, set crunchy, dipped in dark choc, from the Diagon Alley joke shop

Golden honeycomb that foams up in the pot like a joke shop trick, set crunchy, broken into shards and half dipped in dark chocolate. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar and 80g golden syrup in a deep saucepan, stirring until dissolved, then boil without stirring until it turns deep amber, about 6 minutes. Take off the heat, whisk in 1.5 tsp bicarb quickly and pour straight into the tin as it foams. Leave 1 hour to set, then smash into shards. Dip half of each into 150g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper.
K: Honey, lemon and cinnamon water over ice, topped with cold ginger beer
Honey stirred into warm water with lemon and a cinnamon stick, cooled and topped with ginger beer over ice.

veg.make_ahead: Stuffing up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and a little flesh to make a hollow, and chop the scooped flesh.
Fry the onion, sage and chopped pumpkin flesh in the stuffing butter until soft.
Mix with the torn sourdough, egg and salt for a stuffing.
Pack the stuffing into both halves, press the pumpkin back together and tie with kitchen string.
Rub the pumpkin and potatoes with the oil and roast at 180C, potatoes around the pumpkin, until a skewer slides easily into the pumpkin.
Rest the pumpkin for 10 minutes, then cut into thick slices.
Cook the sprouts and toss with the sprout butter.

s.note: Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, small shortcrust fruit mince tarts
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Cut shortcrust into small rounds, press into a patty tin, fill with fruit mince and bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Arrange both on trays for the Slug Club party.

s.note: Puff pastry cases of creamy mushrooms with thyme, an old fashioned party nibble
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 16 rounds of pastry with a 6cm cutter, then cut a smaller circle half way through each. Brush with egg and bake 15 minutes until puffed. Push the centres down while warm. Cook the mushrooms, garlic and thyme leaves in the butter for 8 minutes until the liquid is gone. Stir in the flour, then the cream, and simmer 2 minutes until thick. Season. Spoon into the cases and finish with chopped parsley.

m.note: Turkey breast rolled around sage and onion sourdough stuffing, roasted
m.how: Fry a chopped onion with sage, mix with torn sourdough and season for a stuffing. Butterfly a 1.5kg turkey breast, spread with stuffing, roll and tie. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes with 1kg potatoes around it. Serve with buttered brussels sprouts.

w.note: Pineapple chunks simmered in syrup, then dried
w.how: Cut 1 peeled pineapple into 3cm chunks. Simmer 400g sugar and 400ml water, add the pineapple and cook very gently for 1 hour until translucent. Drain, dry on a rack in a 90C oven for 2 hours until tacky, then roll in caster sugar.

w.note: Dark chocolate and cream truffles rolled in cocoa
w.how: Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir until smooth and chill for 2 hours until firm. Roll into small balls, coat in cocoa and press a pink sugar heart on top. Keep chilled and do not give them to anyone you fancy.

d.note: Honey, lemon and cinnamon water over ice, topped with cold ginger beer
d.how: Stir 4 tbsp honey into 250ml warm water with the juice of a lemon and a cinnamon stick. Leave to cool and infuse for 30 minutes. Pour over ice in glasses and top up with cold ginger beer. A drink for a professor's party.
